frames.s: ATE THE WHOLE FRIDGE AFTER YOUR RUN?

frames.u: Eat within an hour, not at 3pm.
Add some to every meal, not just dinner.
Drink first. Then raid the fridge.

reel1.caption:
Ate the whole fridge after your run and still hungry? Runger is real.
Usually it's a skipped meal, an empty tank on the run, too little protein, or plain thirst.
Save this for your next long run.

#runnerproblems #runningfuel #postrun #runnersofinstagram #PaceShark

frames.u: Race day is not the time to find out.
Half a gel first. More each week.
Same gels, same drink, same timing.
And what sent you looking for a bush.

reel2.caption:
Your legs aren't the only thing that needs training. Your stomach does too.
Practise fuelling on long runs, start small, and use what you'll race with.
Which race are you training for? Tell me below.

#guttraining #longrunfuel #marathonfuel #ultrarunning #PaceShark

slides.sub: 6 steps. Two runners is enough to begin. Swipe.

slides.title: PICK ONE SLOT
slides.head: Same day, same time, every week.
slides.body: People come back to a habit, not a schedule that changes.

slides.title: KEEP IT EASY
slides.head: Choose a loop everyone can finish.
slides.body: A 5 km loop works for beginners and fast runners doing extra laps.

slides.title: NOBODY GETS DROPPED
slides.head: Set regroup points along the way.
slides.body: The fast runners wait. That's the rule that keeps people coming back.

slides.title: ADD THE COFFEE
slides.head: Make the stop after the run part of it.
slides.body: Half your members will come for the chat. That's fine.

slides.title: BRING A FRIEND
slides.head: Ask every runner to bring one person.
slides.body: Word of mouth beats any poster.

slides.title: SHOW UP ANYWAY
slides.head: Run even when it's just two of you.
slides.body: Every big club started with a few people who kept turning up.

slides.sub: Run with a club? Add it on PaceShark: link in bio.
